# SSH MCP

> SSH MCP is a Rust Model Context Protocol server for remote shells, commands, SFTP, rsync, TCP forwards, serial devices and push subscriptions.

## Documentation

- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): module boundaries and lifecycle design.
- [API](docs/API.md): tools, arguments and responses.
- [Resources](docs/RESOURCES.md): subscription URIs, cursors and notifications.
- [Configuration](docs/CONFIGURATION.md): environment variables and limits.
- [Development](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md): build, test and contribution workflow.
- [Operations](docs/OPERATIONS.md): deployment and runtime operations.
- [Migration](docs/MIGRATION.md): version-specific migration guidance.

## Architecture corpus

- [Validated corpus](doc/arch/functional/functional.md): functional behavior and requirements.
- [Quality scenarios](doc/arch/quality/quality-scenarios.md): measurable quality scenarios.
- [Threat model](doc/arch/threat-model/threat-model.md): security boundaries and mitigations.
